2609.31281.title: MA-WAM: Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Test-Time Planning
2609.31281.paper_summary: Multi-agent cooperative tasks require different agents to execute a joint action simultaneously, and each agent's action affects both the observations and responses of the other agents. Hence, a world model is needed to predict the team return resulting from the joint actions of all agents. A naive extension directly applies a single-agent world model to each agent's action when predicting the team return step by step. However, such an extension fails to capture the dependencies among the simultaneous actions of multiple agents. We propose Multi-Agent World-Action Model (MA-WAM), a test-time planning framework that enables a frozen multi-agent flow policy to evaluate futures of candidate joint actions. To our knowledge, MA-WAM is the first test-time world-model planner for multi-agent flow policies. MA-WAM predicts the consequences of each joint action according to cross-agent dependencies and enables efficient candidate scoring. Across 30 offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) settings on MAMuJoCo, SMAC, and MPE, MA-WAM achieves mean relative gains of 22.0% over direct execution and 25.6% over uniform action selection. Under the standard evaluation protocol on an A100 GPU, MA-WAM adds 12.1 ms, accounting for 2.5% of the measured generation-and-scoring time.
2609.31281.paper_summary_zh: 多智能體合作任務需要不同的智能體同時執行聯合行動，而每個智能體的行動都會影響其他智能體的觀察和反應。因此，需要一個世界模型來預測所有智能體聯合行動所帶來的團隊回報。簡單的擴展直接將單一智能體的世界模型應用於每個智能體的行動，以逐步預測團隊回報。然而，這種擴展無法捕捉多個智能體同時行動之間的依賴關係。我們提出了多智能體世界行動模型（MA-WAM），這是一個測試時規劃框架，能夠使凍結的多智能體流政策評估候選聯合行動的未來。據我們所知，MA-WAM 是首個針對多智能體流政策的測試時世界模型規劃器。MA-WAM 根據跨智能體的依賴關係預測每個聯合行動的後果，並實現高效的候選評分。在 MAMuJoCo、SMAC 和 MPE 的 30 個離線多智能體強化學習（MARL）設置中，MA-WAM 相對於直接執行實現了 22.0% 的平均相對增益，並相對於均勻行動選擇實現了 25.6% 的增益。在 A100 GPU 上的標準評估協議下，MA-WAM 增加了 12.1 毫秒，佔測量生成和評分時間的 2.5%。
